texts.facts: Page No.# 5/5 Perusal of the instant case record reveals that the earlier Lawazima Court vide its order dated 01.12.2021 had directed the petitioner to take fresh steps for issuance of notice to the respondent Nos. 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 14, 16, 17, 18 & 19 by way of registered post with A/D, within 7 (seven) days from the date of the said order. Thereafter, when the instant matter was listed again before the Lawazima Court on 20.06.2025, the said Lawazima Court was pleased to allow the petitioner some more time to comply with the Lawazima Court's order dated 01.12.2021. However, a perusal of the recent office note dated 19.11.2025 reveals that the petitioner has not yet taken any steps for issuance of notice to the respondent Nos. 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11, 14, 16, 17, 18 & 19, despite being repeatedly directed to that effect. In view of the observations made above, it may be discerned that the petitioner may not be interested to pursue the case.
